timing_definition: Measured work-time estimate for a fresh merge: calibration when required plus export and read-back audit; both serial stages included. Excludes queue, runtime setup, parent acquisition, and all benchmark evaluation. First seven exports use task duration and include process startup. Shared foundation cost is charged in full to every dependent row, not amortized.
